description: Environment smoke step 1 fixture: rectangular stock with a rectangular top blind cavity. Explicitly simpler than the protocol rounded-pocket G0; not a Q3 or G0 artifact.
tolerance_note: Protocol STEP tolerances: every bounding-box extremum within 0.001 mm and volume error within max(0.001 mm3, 1e-6 * original volume). The smoke-only analytic comparison reuses exactly these tolerances.
analytic_note: scripts/smoke_geometry.py derives stock 20x16x10 = 3200 mm3, cavity 8x6x3 = 144 mm3, and final 3056 mm3 by ordinary arithmetic on the intervals above; no expected volume is read back from this file.
